name: PM2 Monitor
description: Monitor PM2 processes, inspect recent logs, and manage selected processes on the server connected to this pane.

optional.reason: Export displayed log snapshots to a local file you explicitly choose. Logs may contain secrets or personal data; choose a trusted location. Monitoring does not require this permission.

required.reason: Open independent PM2 monitoring panes in your workspace.
Run PM2 commands on this pane's server to inspect processes and logs, and perform actions you confirm. This grants remote command execution as your SSH user.
Ask before starting, restarting, reloading, stopping, deleting, or saving processes.
